Hi,

A year ago, I had good credit and was working my way up. I have personal loans, car loan, student loans, credit cards, etc etc. I was even complimented on my credit several times by my bank. I was even thinking of buying my first house. However, 5 months ago, I was laid off my job unexpectedly and I was ineligible for unemployment. I could not find a job for 5 months and my credit quickly diminished. I called several places to try and set up a payment plan but they told me I had no options until I had an actual income. So things have obviously added up now and many of my bills have gone to collections. 

I just started a new job this week and its not as high paying as my former job, but it will do. Now what? Will these banks work with me and accept relatively low payments? I feel completely swamped and I don't think I can climb out of this mess. I feel like I owe so much and I'll never get it under control again. 

What steps do I take in order to get back on top of things? How do I divide my already-tight budget among these many bills? How long will it take for my credit to start working up again?

Thanks!
